registry.name: Core spread edge
registry.rule: Bet the side whose model margin differs from the closing spread by >= 2.0 pts and whose expected value at the quoted price is >= +2%.

registry.name: Core total edge
registry.rule: Bet over/under when the model total differs from the closing total by >= 2.5 pts and EV >= +2%.

registry.name: Wide spread edge
registry.rule: As S01 with a 1.0-pt threshold (deliberately looser; tests whether selectivity helps).

registry.name: Selective spread edge
registry.rule: As S01 with a 4.0-pt threshold (only large disagreements with the market).

registry.name: Selective total edge
registry.rule: As S02 with a 4.0-pt threshold.

registry.name: Rest advantage
registry.rule: Rest differential >= 4 days between the two teams AND model edge >= 1.0 pt.

registry.name: Divisional home dog
registry.rule: Divisional game, home team is the underdog, model edge >= 2.0 pts.

registry.name: Fade the big favourite
registry.rule: Closing spread >= 9 pts and the model disagrees by >= 1.5 pts on the underdog.

registry.name: Dome totals
registry.rule: Indoor game only, total edge >= 2.0 pts.

registry.name: Outdoor totals
registry.rule: Outdoor game only, total edge >= 2.0 pts.

registry.name: Moneyline value
registry.rule: Model win probability beats the de-vigged implied probability by >= 3 pts.

registry.name: Moneyline value (selective)
registry.rule: As S11 with a 8-pt gap and EV >= +5%.

registry.name: Two-leg parlay
registry.rule: Each week, parlay the two highest-EV qualifying singles (S01/S02) from different games.

registry.name: Three-leg parlay
registry.rule: Each week, parlay the three highest-EV qualifying singles from different games.

registry.name: Same-game spread + total
registry.rule: Same game, spread leg and total leg both qualify (edge >= 1.5 pts each), priced at the product of the two leg prices (book is assumed to ignore correlation).

registry.name: Rec yards OVER
registry.rule: Receiving yards over our number vs the naive trailing-median line, prior targets >= 4, edge >= 5 pts. Priced at an ASSUMED -110 (see IR-03).

registry.name: Rec yards UNDER
registry.rule: Mirror of T01 on the under side.

registry.name: Rec yards OVER (high usage)
registry.rule: Prior targets >= 6 and edge >= 8 pts (selective variant).

registry.name: Receptions OVER
registry.rule: Receptions over, prior targets >= 4, edge >= 5 pts, assumed -110.

registry.name: Receptions UNDER
registry.rule: Mirror of T04 on the under side.

registry.name: Rush attempts OVER
registry.rule: Carries over for backs with prior carries >= 8, edge >= 5 pts, assumed -110.

registry.name: Rush attempts UNDER
registry.rule: Mirror of T06 on the under side.

registry.name: Prop parlay: two team-mates
registry.rule: Both of the top-two receivers on a team clear the edge filter; parlay priced at the product of two -110 legs (27.4% break-even).

registry.name: Prop parlay: same player, two markets
registry.rule: Same player, targets over AND receptions over; priced at the product of two -110 legs.

registry.name: Always home ATS
registry.rule: Benchmark: bet the home team against the spread every game.

registry.name: Always favourite ATS
registry.rule: Benchmark: bet the favourite against the spread every game.

registry.name: Always over
registry.rule: Benchmark: bet the over every game.

registry.name: Coin-flip ATS
registry.rule: Benchmark: randomly pick a side each game (seeded PRNG).
